observations.result: New route-producer requirement explicitly replaces scope-only acceptance with actual capture and full done positives for unchanged inherited tracked/untracked/symlink endpoints, post-observation mutation rejection, and selected inherited dependency rejection. Both executable tool suites cover this requirement.

Same identity wire shape remains; producer requires immutable version2 authorization and exact HEAD anchor. Selected material anchor/index/worktree checks are repeated by consumers; route receipts refresh F1/F2 scope rather than relying on stale producer observation. Existing global assessor and feature proof boundaries stay strict.

Both modules and applicable schemas must resolve to one actually loaded source or installed layout inside consumer root; mixed layouts/unconsumed copies refuse. Test coverage explicitly includes both active layouts.
Amendment addresses full inherited-work usability and selected-dependency conflict identified independently, without silently weakening generic assessment.
This is proposal approval only. Tests must demonstrate real full completion and mutated refusal through direct and receipt consumers; metadata-only constructed success is not sufficient.

final_verdict.summary: Bounded same-wire route assessment and actual active-layout amendment preserve accepted F1/F2 behavior while maintaining structured proof input and authorization binding. Executable coverage is adequate.
